Thanks team — quick update from our side after the first integration sprint:

- Data delivery: we've uploaded the first 10k anonymized customer records to the secure bucket but saw schema drift on the event_time field (ISO vs epoch).
- Trial window: engineering asked to push the internal acceptance demo from May 18 -> May 20 to account for pre-processing fixes.
- Evaluation: we'll run the first automated quality checks Friday; happy to share the eval plan if helpful.
